_comment: Payloads for the README's completion-card section. gen-readme-sections.mjs renders each one through the real renderer (mcp-server/index.js --render-card) and writes the output between the card-example / card-variants markers, so the README shows what the card actually looks like. 'when' is the curated column; everything else is generated.

changes.description: Settings now has a Filter tab with drag & drop, replacing the old dialog
The old dialog route still works and redirects to the new tab

variants.label: ready

changes.description: Uploads retry twice on a timeout

variants.label: ready + open point
variants.when: A decision is still the user's (`open`) — Ship is not offered until it is answered
